items.title: Reggie Watkins interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 22, 2018
items.q: I had a great mentor, a relatively unknown bassist and composer, Kevin Friesen.

ctx.x: That’s terrific. Most musicians it seems have a moment that they figure I have to go to New York. Was that true for you?

Yeah it is in a way, it is in a way you know, but you know my first goal was the make a living playing music. And so I got out of college. Well first of all I was in college I had a great mentor, a relatively unknown bassist and composer, Kevin Friesen.
